evals.prompt: Create a 10-slide BytePlus customer proposal for a retail client evaluating live commerce. Use the BytePlus brand template, keep all charts and the solution architecture editable, and cite every external claim in speaker notes.
evals.expected_output: An editable 10-slide BytePlus PPTX that uses mapped source layouts, includes notes-based citations, and passes structural and visual validation.

evals.prompt: Turn the supplied workshop outline into a polished 16:9 BytePlus enablement deck. Include a minimal cover, agenda, section dividers, two process slides, a case study, and a closing slide. Do not invent metrics.
evals.expected_output: A coherent BytePlus workshop deck that selects appropriate template roles and contains no unresolved placeholders or unsupported facts.

evals.prompt: Redesign this existing product pitch in BytePlus branding while preserving the slide count and all evidence. Replace the visual hierarchy, keep the tables editable, and document third-party image provenance.
evals.expected_output: A slide-count-preserving editable redesign that retains evidence, follows BytePlus styling, records visual provenance, and passes validation.
